summary: The First Den is a forest world centered on Spawn and the lakeside home, with authored grounds and roads extending to Lumenvale and Hearthmere. The main place combines configured terrain and vegetation with scene-authored settlements, paths, perimeter walls, wildlife and residents; procedural generators build the setting while behavior scripts animate its actors, including four tower wardens.
places: places/main - sole live place; forest terrain, configured site/path/river marks and seeded vegetation support authored settlements and routes to Lumenvale and Hearthmere
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Spawn/home grounds: cob-house, garden, creek and its bank dressing, stone perimeter wall, avenue/plaza, south/east warden towers and home actors
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene + x-1z0.scene - north and west warden towers/wardens share these neighboring cells with the corn maze, fauna and pasture routes
places/main/cells/objects.scene - shared authored object placements for main
places/main/cells/x-1z-1.scene - neighboring authored fauna and environment placements
places/main/cells/x1z-1.scene + x1z0.scene + x0z1.scene - remaining neighboring authored cells around Spawn
places/main/config.yaml - creek river/material and creek-bank path marks plus four tower clearing marks; terrain and decoration bindings
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene + x0z-1.scene + x-1z0.scene - four tower/warden pairs: north Rowan, east Ash, south Briar and west Willow
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry/default main place, player and camera templates, lighting, arrival and UI
templates/player.js#player - composed player movement, gait, home interaction and delete-mode behaviors
templates/camera.js#camera - custom first-/third-person camera with long far clip
places/main/config.yaml - forest terrain, atmosphere/clouds, Spawn gravity, site/path/river marks and procedural vegetation bindings
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#cob-house - multi-level home at (0, 0.5, -26), cellar through roof deck, with generated greenery and roofbloom child parts
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#grounds-plan + #grand-avenue - authored flagstone network links avenue/plaza to house grounds and outbuildings; grounds-plan itself is non-colliding
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#grand-gate - frame with two proximity-driven kinematic leaves at the front approach
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#warden-tower-e/#warden-tower-s + neighboring north/west tower rows - four procedural lookout towers topped by crystal lights and paired staffed wardens
shared: scripts/forest-terrain.js - main heightAt/materialAt(ctx) contract for terrain and terrain-relative placements
scripts/gen/forest-plant.js + scripts/gen/valley-mesh.js - seeded forest vegetation builders reused by decoration layers
scripts/lib/road-solid.js - shared solid geometry for bridges and roadside features; deer-fence builds its own runs and stone-wall variant
scripts/lib/yard-kit.js - geometry/material primitives reused by yard-fence, yard-furnish, vine-arch and flower-bed generators
scripts/lib/home-interaction.js + scripts/lib/data/home-feel.js - player press targeting and home interaction tuning
scripts/lib/data/player.yml + scripts/lib/data/ropes.js - player movement, flight and rope tuning used by player behavior
scripts/lib/data/dune.yml, fairies.yml, pollinators.yml, golem.yml, wardens.yml - route, activity, appearance and greeting tuning consumed by actor/manager scripts
scripts/gen/warden-tower.js + scripts/warden-crystal.js - tower geometry and breathing crystal behavior reused by four lookout towers
notableExports: scripts/forest-terrain.js - GROUND, SITES, LAKE, heightAt(ctx), materialAt(ctx)
scripts/player.js - onSpawn(ctx), onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt); scripts/camera.js - finiteNumber(value,fallback), update(ctx,dt)
scripts/gen/grand-avenue.js - geometry(ctx), collider(); scripts/gen/grand-gate.js - geometry(ctx), collider(ctx)
scripts/gen/garden-statue.js - geometry(ctx), collider(ctx); scripts/gen/lawn-sprig.js - geometry(ctx), collider()
scripts/gen/animal-dog.js - P, skeleton(), geometry(ctx); scripts/dune.js - updateSchedule, update(ctx), ears.press
scripts/fairies.js + scripts/pollinators.js - updateSchedule, update(ctx) manager entry points
scripts/stone-golem.js - updateSchedule, legal(ctx,x,z), update(ctx,dt), ears.press; scripts/grand-gate-leaf.js - update(ctx,dt)

scripts/gen/creek-banks.js - geometry(ctx), collider(); scripts/gen/deer-fence.js - geometry(ctx), collider(); scripts/gen/warden-tower.js - PLAT, RISE, TH0, rAt, LAST_A, stairStep, ROOF_POSTS, geometry(ctx), collider(); scripts/tower-warden.js - updateSchedule, onSpawn(ctx), update(ctx,dt), ears
ownership: places/main/config.yaml + scripts/forest-terrain.js - terrain seed/material/site marks, scatter and derived ground height/material; configured marks lay lawns, paths, creek and clearings
places/main/cells/*.scene - authored row IDs, locations, tags, initial state and fixed structure/actor relationships
scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - movement intent, velocity, jump, flight and rope behavior; high-frequency scratch in ctx.session
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/camera.js - player yaw/gait channels and camera view/eye/local-player visibility
scripts/fauna-ground.js / scripts/fauna-small.js, scripts/fairies.js, scripts/pollinators.js - movement/activity and animation state for tagged wildlife populations
scripts/dune.js - Dune's waypoint, roam/greet/treat state and spawned treat lifecycle; per-tick scratch in ctx.session, tuning in dune.yml
scripts/tower-warden.js + scripts/lib/data/wardens.yml - each warden's ring patrol, look/greet state, one-greeting-per-approach tracking and spoken-line cooldown
scripts/stone-golem.js + scripts/grand-gate-leaf.js - Mossback locomotion/interactions and each gate leaf's open flag; gate state uses shared center, openBy and lead fields
flows: places/main/config.yaml terrain generator + seed -> scripts/forest-terrain.js heightAt/materialAt(ctx) -> engine terrain, river channels and forest material bands
places/main/config.yaml site/path/river marks + decoration layers -> terrain clearing, grading, lawn material and seeded forest/lawn vegetation; scene rows separately draw paths and structures
road marks in places/main/config.yaml -> route corridors; authored cells add bridges, dressing, signs and rest features toward Lumenvale/Hearthmere
move/look/jump/camView input -> scripts/player.js -> movement, jump, flight and camMode; place gravity applies to player body
movement near rope coordinates -> scripts/player.js + lib/data/ropes.js -> climb/slide velocity and deck step-in; player body/camMode -> camera view and visibility
interact press -> scripts/home-player-feel.js + lib/home-interaction.js -> nearest aligned press; pet press writes petAt/petBy for fauna, catio and pasture responses
Dune press ear -> scripts/dune.js treats queue -> update spawns/animates dog-treat row; Dune moves, eats, wags and responds to pet state using dog clips
fairy-keeper + pollinator-keeper updates -> scripts/fairies.js and scripts/pollinators.js read their data and tagged rows -> terrain-following flight, activity clips, greetings and effects
stone-golem press ear + update -> scripts/stone-golem.js reads golem.yml and writes locomotion/clip/glow state; tagged Mossback follows bounded lawn patrol

warden rows in scene + scripts/lib/data/wardens.yml -> scripts/tower-warden.js update -> ring patrol/look/greeting; nearby players trigger staff flash, chime and greeting effect, while press ear speaks a line
player proximity -> scripts/grand-gate-leaf.js update on each leaf -> open/openBy state and hinge rotation; lead leaf emits gate creak/thud sounds

configured creek-banks path mark -> creek bed/bank terrain materials; x0z0.scene creek-banks row + scripts/gen/creek-banks.js -> authored bank rocks, reeds, ferns and tufts; grounds-plan draws separate paths
behaviorFamilies: places/main/config.yaml decoration layers + scripts/gen/forest-plant.js / valley-mesh.js - seeded forest plants, trees, shrubs, ferns, reeds and lawn flora varied by layer, kind and terrain
scripts/gen/cob-house.js - procedural multi-level house geometry/collider with cellar, spiral stair and roof deck; greenery and seeded roofbloom parts are non-colliding
scripts/gen/road-bridge.js + scripts/lib/road-solid.js - reusable bridge geometry/collider varied by dimensions and seed
scripts/gen/deer-fence.js - perimeter runs and gates vary by points, width and style; stone style builds coursed limestone wall, coping, moss/ivy and piers

scripts/gen/animal-{bear,deer,fox,wolf}.js + scripts/fauna-ground.js and scripts/gen/critter-{bird,duck,rabbit,squirrel}.js + scripts/fauna-small.js - shared large/small fauna behavior varied by species, geometry, animation and individual state
scripts/gen/flower-bed.js + scripts/gen/lawn-sprig.js + scripts/gen/garden-statue.js - home-garden dressing varied by shape, dimensions, palette and plant/statue kind
scripts/gen/pollinator.js + scripts/pollinators.js - bees, butterflies and dragonflies share flight/activity management, varied by species, variants, beds and tuning

scripts/gen/grand-avenue.js, grand-gate.js + grand-gate-leaf.js and scripts/gen/warden-tower.js + scripts/tower-warden.js - repeated avenue/gate/tower structures and shared proximity/patrol actors vary by dimensions, orientation and per-tower configuration
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-terrain.js - no current place config selects it; main uses forest-terrain
scripts/jade-dragon.js - no scene behavior row attaches this actor script; scene managers may still use separate scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js geometry
migrationNotes: forest-terrain.js heightAt/materialAt take a context object; main's river is at sea level y=0, ground is around y=0.5, and Spawn clearing is centered near (0,-3).
Keep places/main/config.yaml material IDs, clear/flatten marks and decoration bindings coordinated; Spawn/home grounds are centered near (0,-27), outbuildings and pasture use separate site marks.
Configured terrain path marks grade/materialize terrain and clear scatter; scene path generators such as grounds-plan draw visible flagstone paths and do not replace those terrain jobs.

The den-creek follows its authored river points through Spawn under creek-bridge-avenue toward the back pond; the 4.2 m den-creek-banks path and creek-banks scene dressing are separate and should track that course.

Deer-fence run pts are local ground points; style: stone changes the wall geometry and collider, while legacy runs/gates retain the timber-wire default. Tower wardens' state.center is the platform centre and must stay aligned with their tower positions.

Dune, fairy and pollinator clips map from anim/*.yml in world.facts.yaml; warden uses its configured greeting clip and staff attachment, while tower crystals use their own onSpawn bob behavior. Grand-gate leaves share center, openBy and lead state.
